description.name: Switch Draw Mode (Ice, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice]/[Attach Dark] after using a Ice/Dark ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Kiros
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Exsanguination (0~2), removed after using Apex Exsanguination two times

description.name: Apex Exsanguination Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Exsanguination level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Kiros]

description.name: Apex Exsanguination Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Exsanguination level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Kiros]
